correctness.rationale: An explicit complex-pole cyclic inverse formula is algebraically derived for every integer n>=2 and all h>0. Its coefficient signs are classified for n*theta<=pi, pi<n*theta<2pi, and all n*theta>=2pi by a rigorous k=ceil(3pi/(2theta)) sine witness and rho^n<=exp(-2pi), with h=0 and the unique boundary-zero coefficient separately handled. The two-stage stability function is independently derived from the Butcher tableau. The code included here passed 25,420 exact-rational or trigonometric consistency assertions; these checks supplement the analytic all-n proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of stochastic endpoint feasibility for the standard two-stage Lobatto IIIC method on all unit-rate directed cycles, not a one-off numerical sample. The sharp n=4/5 transition and exact h>=cot(pi/n)-1 recovery interval distinguish cyclic from absorbing generators and provide a usable positivity decision without numerical matrix inversions. The explicit inverse kernel is a structural mathematical explanation. No general-purpose norm contractivity or large-step accuracy claim is made.
